title: Poisson problem with Hardy operator on lattice graph $ \mathbb{Z}^d$ and the application to semilinear equations
summary: In this paper, we investigate the analytic properties of the Hardy-type operator $-Δ+ μH_0$ on the $d$-dimensional integer lattice graph $\mathbb{Z}^d$, where $μ\geq -1$ and $H_0$ is a critical Hardy potential at infinity--arising naturally from discrete Hardy inequalities. We derive sharp fixed-pole Green kernel estimates on $\mathbb{Z}^d$ and obtain a necessary and sufficient weighted summability condition characterizing the solvability of the nonnegative Poisson problem associated with this operator.
